messages.subject: Webinar: Warranty & Indemnity insurance in mid-market M&A (CPD 1.5 hours)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Practitioner,

Join our complimentary webinar on the use of warranty and indemnity insurance in mid-market private M&A, covering policy structuring, the interaction with SPA caps and retentions, and recent claims trends. The session qualifies for 1.5 hours of CPD.

Date: 6 November 2025, 12:30pm. Register at lawcpd.co.uk/wi-insurance.

Kind regards,
The LawCPD Events Team
